source.title: Armagh Guardian, 3 June 1927, p. 3 (list of the new county council: "Returned Unopposed" and "Retiring Councillors deemed to be re-elected"); nominations from the Newry Reporter, 28 April 1927, p. 6 ("County Elections: Nominations in Armagh")
source.publisher: Armagh Guardian (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: every name checked against the two page images; returned unopposed, no poll

note: Triennial election of the county council, 1927: nominations received by Thomas E. Reid, secretary, 26 April 1927; the only poll was in Portadown, 26 May 1927. No party labels are printed for the unopposed members in the nominations or the list of the new council, so none are given. Returned unopposed. The nomination lists in the Newry Reporter and the Portadown News print the second name as "H. C. Nicholson"; the list of the new council gives Malcolm.
